input.note: the engine's defaults for every binding, the lowest content layer (design/input.md § Decided, 2026-11-23): each stick a scaled dead zone from 0.125 to 0.925, Unity's, radial where an entry reads both of its axes; each trigger's travel from 30/255, @kama/window's press point; a stick's direction bound to a Digital pressed at 0.5 and let go at 0.375, Unity's; and the gestures' times a gesture naming none of its own takes (design/input.md § Decided, 2026-11-24): a hold 0.4, a tap 0.2, a long tap 0.5, a multi-tap's gap 0.75, a repeat 0.5 then every 0.1, Unity's; an entry's own deadZone, threshold or time takes their place, and a game's input record lays its own over them, part by part
